verdict.rationale: RingCentral's plan documentation says its service comes with local numbers and that the free trial supports up to 20 phone lines, so getting a local business number is part of the offering. Nothing in the pack shows searching available numbers by area code or a fast self-serve purchase flow. Missing for 10: documented area-code number search, self-serve number purchase/provisioning flow (UI or API), evidence that provisioning completes in minutes, independent or hands-on corroboration.
